Ukraine U20 vs Spain U20: Watch Live Stream Online - FIFA U-20 World Cup 07.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of a FIFA U-20 World Cup group stage match, as former world champions, Ukraine, take on one of Europe's strongest teams, Spain. This game promises to be a true highlight of the group stage.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 07, 2025, 19:30 UTC (22:30 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

The Ukraine U20 team, the 2019 World Cup champions, is traditionally a solid and resilient opponent. The team is known for its fighting spirit, tactical discipline, and ability to play on the counter-attack. The Ukrainian squad always features many talented players. For the 'Blue and Yellows,' the match against a formidable opponent like Spain will be key in the battle for first place in the group.

The Spain U20 team is the reigning U-19 European champion and one of the main favorites for the entire tournament. Its squad is packed with future stars of world football from the academies of Barcelona, Real Madrid, and other top clubs. The Spanish rely on their signature 'tiki-taka' style, based on total ball control and combination play.

Head-to-Head (H2H) History

The teams met in the group stage of the 2015 UEFA U-19 European Championship. That match ended in a convincing 3-1 victory for Spain. The teams also crossed paths at the 2023 U-21 EURO, where the Spanish were also stronger, thrashing the Ukrainians 5-1.

Ukraine U20 vs Spain U20 Prediction

Despite Ukraine's status as former world champions, bookmakers and experts consider the Spanish team the favorites. The superior class, technical ability of the players, and a successful head-to-head record all favor the European side.

  • Likely Outcome: A victory for Spain U20.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering the attacking power of the Spanish and the high-scoring nature of their past meetings, a bet on 'Over 2.5 goals' looks highly probable.
  • Key Factor: The total superiority of the Spanish in ball control. Whether Ukraine can counter this with their fighting spirit and counter-attacks.

Tune into the Ukraine U20 vs Spain U20 live stream on tutsport.net and follow the performance of the future stars of world football!

Chile U20 vs Mexico U20: Watch Live Stream Online - FIFA U-20 World Cup 08.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of a Latin American derby in the FIFA U-20 World Cup group stage, as the Chile national team takes on the Mexico national team. This battle between two technical and ambitious teams promises to be very spectacular and tense.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 08, 2025, 23:00 UTC (October 07).

Match Preview and Team Form

The Chile U20 team is traditionally one of the strongest on the South American continent. 'La Rojita' is known for its fighting spirit, technical football, and high-pressing ability. For the Chileans, a successful start to the tournament is of great importance, and they will be fighting for nothing less than a victory against their fierce rivals.

The Mexico U20 team is one of the most decorated in the CONCACAF region and the world, being a U-17 World Cup champion and a U-20 finalist. 'El Tri' relies on fast, combination-based football and the individual skill of its attacking players. Mexico comes into the tournament as one of the 'dark horses' and will be looking to prove their ambitions from the very first match.

Head-to-Head (H2H) History

This will be the first official meeting between the Chile and Mexico U20 national teams at a U-20 World Cup. Their paths have not crossed at this level before, which adds extra intrigue to this fierce Latin American derby.

Chile U20 vs Mexico U20 Prediction

Bookmakers rate the chances of the teams as absolutely even. Both squads have talented players and practice an attacking style of football. The outcome of the match could be decided by any single moment or individual action.

  • Likely Outcome: A high-scoring draw.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering the attacking style of both teams, a bet on 'Both Teams to Score - Yes' and 'Over 2.5 goals' looks very appealing.
  • Key Factor: The battle for midfield and finishing ability. The team that can better capitalize on its chances in attack will be closer to victory.

Tune into the Chile U20 vs Mexico U20 live stream on tutsport.net and follow a vibrant Latin American derby at the World Cup!
